info.title: MemoryControlPlaneService
info.description:
Admin API for the Redis Agent Memory control plane.

Fields marked `x-deployment: cloud` are available on Redis Cloud only. They are always optional,
and on-prem deployments never return them.

get.description:
List the built-in sensitive-data detectors a store can select in its
`longTermMemoryExclusions.builtInDetectors` configuration. Selecting an id this
endpoint does not list is rejected.
Reports that this API process can answer requests, independently of downstream dependencies.
Evaluates the same serving dependencies as the operational readiness probe. Returns 503 without dependency details when the service cannot serve requests.

Get reference data for registering custom memory types.

Returns the reserved built-in memory type names (which a custom memory type
name must not collide with) and the system record fields present on every
memory record, for display in memory-type registration UIs. This is static
reference data and is not scoped to any store.

Register a custom memory type on a store. Its name, description and fields cannot
change afterwards. A registered or retired name is a 409. A concurrent registry
change may return 412; read the current registry and retry.

delete.description:
Unregister a custom memory type without deleting existing memories or Search
index fields. First disable its session extraction strategy and remove every
document Extractor bound to it; otherwise this returns 409. The removed name
is permanently reserved within this store to protect stored attribute schemas.
Requests or extraction jobs already admitted with an older store configuration
may finish. This operation is not a write barrier or a data purge.
An optional expectedRevision protects against stale deletion (412 on mismatch).
Even when omitted, a concurrent registry change may return 412; read and retry.

LongTermMemoryConfigInput.description:
Long-term memory configuration.

On Redis Cloud, `llm` and `embedding` select the store's own models and must be
supplied together; `classification` is independent. Omit them to use the platform
models. The embedding model cannot be changed after the store is created.

sessionSummaryEnabled.description:
Extract session summaries into long-term memory. Takes effect only when the
deployment enables session summary extraction.

ttlSeconds.description: Time-to-live in seconds for long-term memory entries. Defaults to 1 year.

LongTermMemoryConfigStatus.description:
Long-term memory configuration. On Redis Cloud, `embedding`, `llm`, and
`classification` are present only when the store selected its own models.

sessionSummaryEnabled.description: Whether session summary extraction into long-term memory is enabled for this store.

ttlSeconds.description: Time-to-live in seconds for long-term memory entries.

LongTermMemoryConfigUpdate.description:
Long-term memory configuration. Omitted fields keep their current value.

On Redis Cloud:
- `embedding`: only the credential can be replaced.
- `llm`: the model can be changed within the same provider, and the credential
  replaced.
- `classification`: same as `llm`. A store without a classification model may
  select one.

A store created with the platform models cannot switch `embedding` or `llm` to its
own models.

OwnershipConfigInput.description: Controls server-side ownership checks. INHERIT uses the tenant default, then ownership.enabled. Omitted on create means inherit; omitted on update leaves the setting unchanged. When enabled, agent keys need a bound userId or verified delegated user token to access personal content; keys without a user ID can access only shared content within their store grants. Existing ownerless records become hidden and Summary Views with a different ownership policy must be recreated. Disabling restores legacy access. Changes propagate through the metadata cache.

Resource revision. Opaque: each change to a resource's own configuration writes a
new value, and a resource never gets a value it had before. Compare for equality
only; its format is the service's, so only its length is constrained. Returned as
`revision`; sent back as `expectedRevision` to make a write conditional. Omitting
`expectedRevision` makes the write unconditional.
